transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. It's really nice to meet you, too. Thank you for taking the time to see me. 

Um... well, I'm here because... I guess I just want to clear some things up, if that's alright? I really don't want to be any trouble, and I want to do whatever I'm supposed to do. It's just... people keep acting like I'm imagining things, which I'm not, I promise. But I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been... well, they've been watching our house. And even keeping an eye on my cleaning routes when I'm at work. 

I know how that might sound, but I really think they just want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. Which I am! I take very good care of him, I always make sure he has everything he needs. Does that make sense? I just want everyone to see that I'm doing a good job.
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is there?

Oh, um... well. I hope you won't think badly of me if I answer that honestly. I really don't want you to think I'm... well, you know. I'm doing a very good job at home, I promise. 

But... yes. Sometimes, even when the house is completely quiet, I do hear a woman's voice. She's usually right near the kitchen window. She isn't mean or anything! She actually just tells me to check the locks, or... or she'll tell me to move my husband's pills so everything is safe and organized. It's just... it's as clear as if she is standing right there next to me. 

I hope that doesn't sound too strange? I just try to look at it as a little extra help to make sure I'm keeping him safe and doing things right. Is it alright that I told you that?
Have there been times when you felt unusually full of energy and needed much less sleep than usual?

Well... I hope it's okay to say this, because I really don't want you to think I'm overworking myself or anything. I just want to be as helpful as I can. But... yes, I suppose I have been having a lot of energy lately. 

Many nights, I'll only sleep for maybe two or three hours. And the wonderful thing is, I don't feel tired at all! Not like I used to after a short night, anyway. I just wake up and I'm completely ready to go—I'll get right to scrubbing the floors or sorting through all our papers. It actually helps me make sure the house is absolutely perfect before I have to go out for my own cleaning jobs. 

That's a good thing, right? I just figure it's a little extra time my body is giving me to make sure everything is taken care of properly for my husband. I hope you don't mind me doing that... I really am just trying to do a good job.
Have you had a period when you felt very depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Oh, um... depressed? Well, I... I don't think so. I really try my best to keep a smile on my face, you know? I wouldn't want to bring anyone down, especially not my husband. 

So, no, I haven't really had days where I'm just sad all day like that. I always make sure I get up and do my work, and keep everything nice and tidy. I hope that's a good thing? I really just try to be as cheerful and helpful as I can be... I wouldn't want you to think I was just sitting around feeling sorry for myself or neglecting my duties. Is it alright that I don't feel that way?
Do you ever hear that woman’s voice at times when your energy and sleep are normal?

Oh, um... well, I hope you won't think I'm making things up or being difficult. I really try to be honest with you. But, yes... yes, I do. 

There was actually a spell, maybe for a few weeks, where things were a lot quieter. I was sleeping a normal amount, you know, not rushing around cleaning all through the night like I was telling you about. I was just taking it a little easier. But... even then, I still heard her. The voice by the kitchen window. She was still there. And... well, I still felt very strongly that the agency was keeping an eye on us, making sure everything was being done right. 

I hope it's okay that she was still there even when I was resting? I didn't want you to think I was only hearing her because I was tired or working too hard. I promise I was still taking good care of the house during that time... is it alright that I told you that?
Before these experiences started, did you have any major medical illness or injury to your brain?

Oh, um... no, sir. I really haven't. I mean, I've always tried to stay as healthy as possible so I can keep up with my work. I wouldn't want to be a burden on anyone, you know? 

I've never had any kind of brain injury or... or any major sickness like that. I've always been very careful, making sure I eat right and don't do anything reckless. I hope that's what you were looking for? I just want to reassure you that there's nothing physically wrong with me like that... I've always tried my best to take good care of myself. Is that alright?
Have there been times when you felt you had special powers or were especially important?

Oh, my... special powers? Goodness, no, I wouldn't ever say I had anything like that. I'm just a regular person, you know, just doing my work. I wouldn't want you to think I was getting arrogant or putting on airs. 

But... well, I suppose there was a time when I felt very... responsible? I hope it doesn't sound boastful, I really don't mean it to be. It's just that, well, I started feeling like... like I was the only one who really had the sense and the strength to keep everyone safe from what was coming. 

I just felt so strongly that it was entirely up to me to protect my husband, and my home, and even some of the church people. Like I was the only one who could do it. I just wanted to be as helpful and protective as I could be, making sure everyone was taken care of. I hope you don't think poorly of me for saying that, or think I was being too prideful... I just care about them so much. Is it alright that I felt so important to them?
During those times when you had lots of energy and slept very little, did you feel unusually euphoric or especially irritable?

Oh, well... I always try to keep a very cheerful disposition, you know, especially for my clients. I want everyone to be happy with my work. And during those stretches... well, I do feel just wonderfully bright and strong. Like I can handle absolutely everything, all the chores and the organizing, without any trouble at all. It feels good to be so capable.

But... oh, I feel a little ashamed to admit this, because I really pride myself on being polite and respectful. Sometimes, if I'm in the middle of all that and my husband, or maybe one of my cleaning clients, questions how I'm doing something... I can be a bit short. 

I end up snapping at them, much harder than I ever mean to. I always feel just terrible about it right after. I hope you don't think I'm a mean-spirited person for losing my temper like that? I really don't want to be difficult or rude... I just get so wound up trying to get it all done perfectly. Is it alright that I told you that? I promise I always try to apologize when it happens.
When you were sleeping only two or three hours and still felt full of energy, did that period last at least one full week?

Oh, um... a full week? Well, I don't want to make it sound like I'm completely out of control for long stretches of time. I really do try my hardest to stay grounded and keep my routines going, you know? I wouldn't want you to think I'm just running wild. 

But... well, if I'm being completely honest—and I do want to be a good patient for you—these periods where I'm just so full of energy, and maybe a little too snappy, and hardly sleeping at all... they've been coming and going for a while now. I suppose it's been about 10 months that it's been happening on and off. 

Some weeks it's exactly like that, where I just keep going and going. I always try to use the time to get extra cleaning done, so at least I'm being productive! I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. Is it okay that it's been happening on and off for that long? I really am trying my best to manage it.
Have there ever been at least two weeks when you were hearing the woman’s voice or felt watched, but you were not unusually energetic or unusually irritable during that time?

Oh, um... well, I really hope you don't think I'm completely losing my mind when I say this. I try so hard to just be normal and not bother anyone with my worries. But... yes, I suppose there was a time exactly like that. 

There was a... a quieter spell, I guess you'd call it, for several weeks. I wasn't rushing around doing all those extra chores, and I was actually sleeping a lot more. I was really trying to be good and get my proper rest, like I know I'm supposed to! But... oh, it's a little embarrassing to admit... even when I was feeling calm and rested, I still heard her. That woman's voice... right by the kitchen window. And I still really, truly believed that the agency was watching us. 

I didn't want to cause a fuss, so I just tried to keep quiet about it and do my work. I hope I'm answering your question the right way? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to know, even if it sounds a bit strange. Is it okay that I was still experiencing all of that, even when I was resting?
